description:
LV PROPERTY are delighted to present an exquisite one-bedroom apartment within the prestigious Lexington Gardens development.
Located in a prime residential area, this stunning apartment offers modern living in a highly sought-after community. Here are the key features of this remarkable property:
This apartment boasts a spacious and well-designed bedroom, providing a comfortable and private retreat. It offers ample space for a cozy bed, storage units, and personal belongings. Large windows flood the room with natural light, creating an inviting and relaxing atmosphere.

The contemporary bathroom is elegantly designed and fitted with high-quality fixtures and fittings. It features a luxurious shower/bathtub combination, a sleek vanity unit, and modern sanitary ware. It's the perfect place to unwind and rejuvenate after a long day.

The apartment features a fully equipped, modern kitchen that is a dream for any culinary enthusiast. It includes top-of-the-line appliances, ample cabinet space, and stylish countertops. Whether you're cooking a quick meal or hosting a dinner party, this kitchen has everything you need.
The open-plan living area offers a generous space for relaxation and entertainment. The tastefully decorated living room provides a comfortable setting to unwind, entertain guests, or simply enjoy a quiet evening at home. Large windows showcase panoramic views of the surrounding neighborhood, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.
Residents of Lexington Gardens have access to an array of amenities, including a beautifully landscaped communal garden, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and secure underground parking. The development is also equipped with 24-hour security, ensuring peace of mind for all residents.

Situated in a highly desirable neighbourhood, Lexington Gardens offers excellent connectivity to local amenities and transport links. The development is within walking distance of shops, cafes, restaurants, and public transportation options.
